title: Brief special meeting before closed session
subtitle: Council authorized a closed session on land, property security, litigation and negotiations, then adjourned within minutes.
overview: Kitchener City Council held a short special meeting on April 13, 2026, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. The meeting opened at 4:05 p.m. with a Land Acknowledgement. No pecuniary interests were declared, and the Mayor had no updates.

The only substantive step was authorizing a closed session to follow immediately after the public meeting {{vote:m1}}. The session was to cover five matters: a potential land acquisition, a security of property and solicitor-client privilege matter, litigation or potential litigation with solicitor-client privilege, a position or procedure to be applied to negotiations, and a security of property matter. These fall under the closed-meeting provisions of the Municipal Act, 2001.

The meeting adjourned at 4:07 p.m. No decisions on these topics were made in public, and the minutes record no outcomes from the closed session. Residents should watch for later public reports or announcements if any of these matters lead to council action.

decisions.detail: Council agreed to hold a closed session right after the special meeting on five matters: land acquisition, property security, litigation, negotiations and a second property security matter.
